scope: Prototype k3s server on ONE VirtualBox VM using a standalone Ansible set (ansible-lab), NOT the repo roles in infra/ansible and NOT Terraform/libvirt

vm.name: anuyen-server
vm.storage_controller: VirtIO-SCSI (minimal image boots without initramfs; SATA not detected)

cluster.k3s_version: v1.37.2+k3s1 (channel stable, NOT pinned v1.36.6+k3s1 from infra/versions.json)

backup.mechanism: systemd k3s-backup.timer -> k3s etcd-snapshot save + token copy to /var/backups/k3s

deviations_from_design: VirtualBox instead of libvirt/KVM; no Terraform plan/apply
1 VM only (server); jenkins and agent VMs not provisioned in this run
2 GiB RAM / 20 GiB disk instead of 4 GiB / 48 GiB (infra/lab-budget.json)
User ubuntu instead of clinicops; no UFW, no sshd hardening, no secrets-encryption
k3s from get.k3s.io stable channel, not checksum-pinned binary
Backup is etcd snapshot, not repo role 'backup' (clinic PostgreSQL backups)
not_proven: repo infra/ansible site.yml on a clean VM
